subject: Belle, bronze woman in a door frame on a stepped bronze base and a black granite pedestal; Oudekerksplein, unveiled 31 March 2007, commissioned by the Prostitutie Informatie Centrum (nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Belle_(standbeeld))

frame.route: door frame measured on the photo and on Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0), drawn as boxes (scripts/sculptures/statue-parts.ts): outer width 0.365 m, posts 0.85-1.85 m, 30 mm bar, 0.06 m behind the plan centre; rembg drops the 30 mm bars

pedestal.route: granite pedestal measured on the photo and on Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0), drawn as boxes (scripts/sculptures/statue-parts.ts): 0.47 x 0.47 x 0.80 m (the TripoSR pedestal was 0.62 m deep and skewed)

plaque.route: brass plaque measured on the photo and on Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0), drawn as boxes (scripts/sculptures/statue-parts.ts): 0.22 x 0.115 m, centre 0.57 m

figure.route: TripoSR, one photo (isnet-general-use cut-out), decimated to 12k then split at the plinth top

corrections.why: the photo looks down; the reconstructed granite pedestal (a vertical prism) leant forward 0.19 m per metre, the same drift as the figure, so the whole mesh is sheared back by that amount

baseScale.why: the cut-out merged the bronze stepped base with the granite top; the photo shows the base about 0.35 m wide on a 0.47 m pedestal

placement.source: triangulated from eight 2024/2025 Gemeente Amsterdam panorama views (pano-views.ts, statue bearing per view); OSM node 3371945363 (4.8974056, 52.3741786) is 2.4 m south of the statue
placement.facingSource: pedestal front and plaque face the 2025 panorama recording_2025-07-03_03-29-47_02792 looking east (bearing 88 deg) square-on; the Commons photo is taken from the same side (the red-shuttered house with the grey downpipe behind)
placement.heightSource: panorama measurement, three views (2024 Track12 Sphere_00025, 2025 02792 and 02794): frame top 1.78-1.88 m from the triangulated distance, 1.88-2.18 m from the assumed 2.44 m camera height; pedestal top 0.84-0.99 m; Commons photo proportions pedestal/total 0.40-0.46. No published dimension found (nl.wikipedia, Commons, buitenbeeldinbeeld blocked)

command: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 node --import tsx scripts/sculptures/reconstruct.ts --id=belle --rembg=isnet-general-use --no-strip; venv-o3d/bin/python -I scripts/sculptures/decimate_scale_glb.py work/raw.ply work/plain-12k.glb --height=1.85 --facing=268 --tris=12000 --no-colors; node --import tsx scripts/sculptures/statue-parts.ts --in=work/plain-12k.glb --out=parts --split=0.8 --facing=268 --shear=0.19 --pedestal=0.47,0.47 --base-scale=0.78,0.93,1.0 --frame=0.365,0.85,1.85,0.03,0.06 --plaque=0.22,0.115,0.57 --stone-tint=#2a2c2e
